normalized.description: Bord Bia proposes to establish a framework agreement for the provision of Origin Green Mentorship Services, comprising the following service streams: • Provision of Generalist Mentorship Support, including structured one-to-one support to Origin Green members on programme requirements, reporting, and implementation. This support will focus on providing practical, step-by-step guidance to enable members, particularly SMEs, to understand and meet programme expectations. It will include assistance with assistance with understanding targets, materiality, and sustainability strategy development, as well as general sustainability advisory. • Provision of Subject Matter Expert Support, including technical advisory services across a range of sustainability areas, together with the design and delivery of in-depth Learning Labs that provide practical tools, frameworks, and implementation guidance.
